To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
cellulose synthesis and assembly in zygotes is controlled at the translational level.

(i) cellulose synthesis is controlled at the translational and/or post-translational levels, (ii) cellulose synthesis requires a soluble protein, (iii) cellulose synthesis occurs on the inner face of the plasma membrane, and (iv) cellulose synthesis in F. zygotes occurs in two phases, the first being rapid and transient and the second being slower and more sustained.
cellulose synthesis is triggered by fertilization and is controlled at the protein synthesis-independent post-translational step of assembly.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms by which the zygote of Fucus is able to initiate the synthesis of the cell wall polysaccharide cellulose and the assembly of a new cell wall.
the assembly of the cell wall in zygotes and embryos of the seaweeds, Fucus.
the mechanisms by which the zygote of Fucus responds to fertilization and initiates the assembly of a new cell wall.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the initiation of synthesis of cellulose in Fucus is triggered by fertilization and is controlled at the level of enzyme activation.
the initiation of the synthesis of the cell wall of a Fucus zygote is triggered by fertilization and is controlled at the level of the synthesis of cellulose.
the cellulose synthase complex is not activated by the sperm but is activated by a signal generated in the egg by the fertilization event.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cellulose synthesis in Fucus zygotes is regulated by a post-transcriptional mechanism that is controlled by a fertilization signal.

the synthesis and deposition of cellulose is controlled in the zygote at the post-transcriptional and post-translational levels, and that the synthesis and assembly of the cellulose microfibrils in Fucus zygotc cell walls are independent of the synthesis and deposition, or both, of the other wall polymers.
cellulose is synthesized by zygotes of brown algae, but is absent in unfertilized eggs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cell wall assembly is a complex process, and that the initiation of synthesis is a highly regulated event.
the initiation of cell wall assembly is controlled at the protein level.
cell wall assembly during Fucus zygote development is regulated at multiple levels.
